descriptionPlain:
Build better healthcare together

Maple's purpose is to meet the world's healthcare needs. We're Canada's leading on-demand healthcare platform, connecting patients with Canadian-licensed doctors, nurse practitioners and specialists. Today, we're proud that over 8 million patients and 7,000 businesses and government partners have access to same-day, proactive and ongoing care. We enable people to take control of their health and push the boundaries of what's possible every day.

Bold minds. Big impact.

A career at Maple is about making an impact. We empower bold thinking, surround you with an inspiring team and are driven by a motivating purpose. Here, you'll do work that changes lives—including your own.

lists.content:
As we expand into new services and segments, we're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Marketing team. In this role, you'll connect go-to-market strategy across our B2B and B2C channels, with a strong focus on our employer and partner business. You'll own the market, competitor and customer intelligence that informs how we position what we do—and lead commercialization for some of the most exciting product expansions on our roadmap.

This is a high-strategy, high-research role for someone who loves shaping what a service could be. You'll pressure-test the competitive landscape, define the category we want to lead and build the customer advocacy that helps us expand share. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Sales, Client Success and the broader Marketing team to sharpen our value proposition and unlock the highest-impact opportunities to scale. The work you ship will reach real people when they need care most.

As the Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will:

  • Define positioning, messaging and value propositions across our core offerings, and lead go-to-market strategy for new products and services.

  • Own market, competitor and customer intelligence—turning internal and external signals into clear strategic recommendations that shape product and go-to-market decisions.

  • Shape category design and customer advocacy that lifts how Maple shows up in market and helps us expand share.

  • Inform how we package and price what we offer, grounded in data and customer insight.

  • Partner with Product and Growth to improve conversion across key journeys and identify high-impact opportunities to test and scale.

  • Prioritize where to play and where to win—focusing energy on the opportunities that move the business most.

In your first 90 days, you'll get fluent in our customers, our product and the markets we're playing in. You'll build strong relationships across Product, Marketing and our Commercial team, sharpen positioning and messaging for our priority services, and bring a clear point of view on the biggest opportunities ahead—backed by data and a recommended path forward.

Over the next 12 to 18 months, you'll lead go-to-market for major launches, evolve how we package and price to better reflect customer value, and put the product marketing foundations in place that help Maple scale—messaging frameworks, personas and competitive positioning the whole company can rally behind. You'll drive measurable lift in adoption and revenue, and become a trusted strategic partner on growth and market strategy. By the end of this stretch, you'll have shaped a cohesive product marketing approach across our business and helped raise the bar for how we bring products to market.

• 5–7 years of marketing experience, with meaningful time in a product marketing role.

  • Strong B2B product marketing experience, with the judgment to navigate a business that also serves consumers and the public sector.

  • A track record of measurable business impact. You can point to outcomes you drove—deals won, share gained, launches that moved the number.

  • Deep strength in strategy and research: positioning, messaging, competitive analysis, category design and customer advocacy.

  • The ability to connect strategy to execution—you can move between a positioning framework and a conversion test without missing a beat.

  • A data-driven mindset and curiosity that pulls you toward the why behind the numbers.

  • Sharp communication skills—you turn insight into action others can rally behind, and you build the cross-functional relationships that make great work possible.

  • The instincts of a quick study—you can become a credible expert in a new space fast.


    • Play to your strengths. Finding the right fit goes both ways—so this section is yours to complete. When you join, you'll add the unique strengths you bring that aren't captured above.

We recognise our people's health is everything. That's why we take care of them.

  • Maple for you and your family: 24/7 access to general practitioners, pediatrics and mental health therapy for you and your family. Care starts on day one

  • Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental and life insurance because your peace of mind—and your loved ones—matter most

  • Health spending account: Extra funds to cover the essentials that make a difference, from new glasses to specialised therapy

  • Flex benefits: An annual budget built for your growth and well-being. Use it for professional development, wellness expenses or a one-time boost to your retirement savings. You choose what matters most

  • Health days: Life happens. We provide 10 dedicated days for rest, medical appointments or caregiving, so you can show up at your best

  • Destination days: Work from anywhere. Enjoy the flexibility to work internationally in eligible countries for up to five days per year

  • Group retirement savings plan: We're here for the long haul. Invest in your future with our group retirement plan

• Job type: Existing vacancy, full-time

  • Hiring manager: Director, Product Marketing

  • Location: Hybrid, 500 King Street West, 2nd Floor, Toronto, ON, M5V 1L9

  • Start date: August 2026

  • Vacation: 4 weeks

  • Pay range: $120,000–$135,000


    • Offers can vary depending on skills, experience and readiness to meet Maple's expectations for this level. We encourage open conversations about pay. If you have questions about how compensation works at Maple, you're welcome to ask at any point in the interview process.

    We're committed to the safety and security of our platform. Please note that any offer of employment is subject to a criminal record check (EPIC) and identity verification. Additional checks, including employment or education verification, may be conducted depending on the role's requirements.

    Use of artificial intelligence

    We don't currently use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated tools to screen, assess or select candidates. Every application is thoughtfully reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team or hiring managers.
